question: Mubvunzo
defaultDirections: Sarudza mhinduro yaunofunga kuti inopindura mubvunzo. Paunenge wapedza, dzvanya {checkAnswer}. Uchawana mhinduro inoratidza kana mhinduro yako yakarurama uye maenderero ekuita.
relatedContentDescription: Izvi zvinogadzira nzvimbo yakapetwa yezvirimo zvine chekuita nemubvunzo uyu uye inogara ichiratidzwa
hintDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akakanganisa mhinduro
evidenceDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akarurama mhinduro
sortingDirections: Ronga zvinhu nenzira kwayo nekudzvanya miseve yekumusoro nekuzasi kana kudhonza woisa. Kana uchitenda kuti zvakarongwa nenzira kwayo, edza mhinduro yako nekusarudza {checkAnswer}. Uchawana mhinduro pasi pano inoratidza kana mhinduro yako yakarurama.
